summary: 로아이젠 박성기 대표가 휴머노이드와 서비스로봇을 이해하기 위한 연재를 시작하며, 로봇이 물리적 세계를 다루는 피지컬 AI만으로는 충분하지 않고 사람과 사회적 맥락을 해석하는 소셜 AI가 함께 필요하다는 문제의식을 제기한다. 앞으로의 글은 가능한 행동을 넘어 적절한 행동을 고르는 판단, 데이터로 포착되지 않는 사회적 규범, 모방을 넘어선 규범 학습 같은 주제를 통해 로봇 지능의 평가 기준을 성공률 중심에서 사회적 판단과 실행의 책임까지 넓히려는 흐름을 다룰 예정이다.

summary: Charlie Kemp’s profile traces how his AI background at MIT led to Hello Robot’s Stretch, an assistive mobile manipulator designed around everyday use by people with disabilities. The piece emphasizes his people-first approach to robotics: close work with users shapes what the robot should do, how it should fit into homes, and how it can support more independent living.

extra.full_text: Building useful robots starts with understanding the people who use them. title: Who fixes the robots? Field service is the next bottleneck in robotics
summary: As robotics companies push harder on deployment, the article argues that field service is becoming a neglected constraint: robots may be sold and installed, but failures months later still require fast, local diagnosis and repair. The concrete problem is less glamorous than autonomy research but central to scale, since a bad sensor in a remote kitchen can turn uptime, customer trust, and unit economics into the real bottleneck.

extra.full_text: Everyone in the industry is talking about how to build, sell and deploy these robots. Far fewer people are talking about what happens on day 200, when a sensor fails at 6 a.m. in a kitchen 900 miles from the nearest company engineer.

title: “AI로 레일 진단…로봇이 작업자 지킨다”…철도연, 세계 철도박람회서 K-기술 위용
summary: Korea Railroad Research Institute showcased its K-rail technologies at InnoTrans 2026 in Berlin, including AI-based rail inspection aimed at improving maintenance efficiency and worker safety. The exhibit positioned rail-diagnosis AI and robotic systems as practical infrastructure tools for detecting track issues while reducing hazardous on-site work, tying railway automation to safer and greener operations.

title: 印 앤서 로보틱스, FCC로부터 3개 AMR 모델 조건부 승인 받아
summary: ANSCER Robotics’ U.S. sales and service arm has received FCC conditional approval for three autonomous mobile robot platforms, the AR250, AR650, and AR1250, effective September 18. The approval places the robots on the FCC Covered List program’s conditional approval list for robotic devices, clearing an important regulatory step for selling and servicing the Indian AMR maker’s systems in the U.S.

summary: Light Origins launched Light-O1, a general embodied AI foundation model trained at scale on human behavior data extracted from internet videos, with the aim of making one model transferable across many robot platforms. title: RobotPlusPlus Advances Industrial Maintenance with HighMate Series Demonstrated at SMM 2026
summary: RobotPlusPlus showed its HighMate series at SMM 2026 in Hamburg, positioning the robots as tools for industrial cleaning and surface treatment in maintenance environments. The emphasis is on moving workers away from hazardous work at height while making repetitive preparation and cleaning jobs more efficient and consistent.
